prompt:
Score each onboarding change. Sub-scores:
- impact 0-3: how many users the targeted step loses and how much this could recover
- evidence 0-3: whether the funnel and the support mail both point at this problem
- confidence 0-2: how likely this kind of change works, judged from the lessons below
- cost 0-2: 2 = config only, 0 = needs new screens and a release
Also give predicted_lift: expected relative change in the target step's conversion, e.g. 0.05.

Lessons from earlier weeks:
Evidence is still thin for home new_flow changes, as only 1 test has been conducted so far despite winning.
Evidence is still thin for finish new_screen, sign_in hint, and choose_path copy changes, as each has only 1 test showing no clear effect.
Predictions were generally too high, overestimating gains in 3 out of 4 tests.

Measured so far, by kind of change (relative change on the target step):
- choose_path, copy: -0.2% after noise correction, 1 test(s) (one test only: weak evidence, not a pattern yet)
- finish, new_screen: +0.9% after noise correction, 1 test(s) (one test only: weak evidence, not a pattern yet)
- home, new_flow: +4.8% after noise correction, 1 test(s) (one test only: weak evidence, not a pattern yet)
- sign_in, hint: -1.4% after noise correction, 1 test(s) (one test only: weak evidence, not a pattern yet)

Funnel:
- choose_path: 76.2%, median 8s / mean 514s
- sign_in: 72.9%, median 3s / mean 567s
- adoption: 60.9%, median 89s / mean 1017s
- home: 87.4%, median 201s / mean 2336s
- finish: 64.8%, median 395s / mean 5815s
- finishing onboarding overall: 19.2%

Return JSON {"scores": [{"index": i, "impact": n, "evidence": n, "confidence": n, "cost": n,
"predicted_lift": x, "note": short}]}

Changes:
0: [sign_in, reorder] Postpone sign-in after pet adoption: Move sign-in step to after adoption certificate screen so users personalize their pet before creating or logging into an account. (why: Sign-in step drops 27.1% of users early before attachment, and 8 support emails noted account sign-in reset pet data.)
1: [adoption, redesign] Carousel redesign for pet selection: Redesign the pet selection screen into a full visual carousel featuring rich card previews of pre-made pets. (why: Adoption step has low conversion (60.9%) and long decision time (median 89s, mean 1017s).)
2: [finish, new_screen] Desktop control tutorial screen: Add a dedicated interactive guide screen before finishing onboarding that demonstrates desktop controls and tray icon access. (why: 3 support tickets reported post-onboarding confusion over controlling, hiding, or talking to pets, and finish step drops 35.2%.)
3: [home, new_flow] Animated desktop setup progress flow: Rebuild the waiting screen to display step-by-step progress bars and estimated remaining time while pet assets load. (why: Waiting/home screen takes a long time (mean 2336s) and 3 support emails reported desktop pet loading issues.)
4: [adoption, hint] Photo formatting guidance hint: Add explicit photo quality instructions on the photo upload screen regarding lighting and file formats. (why: 3 support complaints noted custom pet generation failing or looking distorted.)
5: [choose_path, layout] Split path selection layout: Change path selection to a side-by-side split layout clearly distinguishing instant pre-made pets from custom pets. (why: choose_path mean time is high (514s), indicating user confusion between paths.)
6: [finish, layout] Spotlight introduction layout: Change home_intro layout to spotlight focus emphasizing desktop pet activation. (why: Finish step dropoff is 35.2% and post-onboarding confusion remains high.)
7: [adoption, wait_info] Photo processing visual indicator: Display status text and progress bar during photo upload verification. (why: Adoption mean time is 1017s and users experience custom pet generation errors.)
8: [choose_path, copy] Clear intro expectation copy: Update story screen intro copy to set quick setup expectations for new desktop pet owners. (why: Overall onboarding completion is only 19.2%, needing better motivation right at the start.)
